Cursor has launched Origin - a Git-based code hosting platform built directly into its AI-powered editor.

Positioned as a GitHub alternative, Origin is now in early beta for Pro, Teams, and Enterprise users via Cursor’s new Codebase tab.

Learn more 👉 https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/08/cursor-origin-alternative-github/
